project_invariants: Build eleven independent domain language/reasoning corpora before deriving the cross-domain editorial framework.
Academic works teach analytical language and reasoning; they do not become runtime factual authority.
The deterministic application retains facts, calculations, provenance, evidence selection, validation, and publication control.
Only one domain is active at a time.
Admission states remain distinct: found, screened, full text accessed, fully analyzed, admitted.
Abstracts, search snippets, publisher previews, citations, and inferred outlines do not satisfy whole-text review.
Whole-text review must cover framing, theory/literature where present, methods/design, results, discussion/implications, and limitations/conclusion.
JIF >= 2.0 is a binary gate, not a ranking signal.
Completion requires conceptual coverage, study-design diversity, two qualifying saturation batches after foundation, long-form analysis, normalization, provenance, and integrity audit.
Preserve atomic observations and anti-patterns; do not legislate final universal rules before all eleven domains are complete.
Create periodic versioned JSON checkpoints and never call a working artifact COMPLETE.
Freeze completed domain artifacts; corrections require a new version rather than silent rewriting.
